    • disableAward

      public SettlementOptions.Builder disableAward(boolean disableAward)
      Skips the loyalty award step, so the member earns no points on this checkout. Redemptions are unaffected — combine with disableRebates(boolean) and disablePoints(boolean) to run a fully loyalty-free charge sequence.

    • cashback

      public SettlementOptions.Builder cashback(BigDecimal cashback)
      Cashback to hand the customer, authorized on top of the sale amount. Must be positive — a negative value would reduce the amount charged and complete the checkout underpaid. Leave unset for no cashback.
